vulnerability.name: Sensitive Data Logging
vulnerability.description: Exposure of sensitive information through application logs
vulnerability.impact: Disclosure of sensitive user data, credentials, or security tokens via log files
vulnerability.mitigation: Filter sensitive data from logs, use proper log levels, and implement secure logging practices

           State Change Logging
          └─────>
